text: The RidgeTent 2P is a 2-person, 3-season backpacking tent weighing 1.9 kg. It uses 20D ripstop nylon with a 3000mm waterproof rating. The tent packs down to 40 x 15 cm and includes two vestibules.
title: RidgeTent 2P specifications

text: The RidgeTent 2P pitches in about 5 minutes with color-coded poles. It is freestanding, so it can be pitched on rock or sand without stakes. Two vestibules provide gear storage on both sides.
title: RidgeTent 2P setup

text: The RidgeTent 2P carries a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover UV damage or misuse. Summitline offers a mail-in repair service for a $25 flat fee.
title: RidgeTent 2P warranty

text: The TrailPack 45 is a 45 liter backpack weighing 1.4 kg. It comes in torso sizes S, M, and L and includes a rain cover. Hip belt pockets and a hydration sleeve are standard.
title: TrailPack 45 specifications

text: To fit the TrailPack 45, measure your torso from the C7 vertebra to the iliac crest. The hip belt should sit centered on the iliac crest. Tighten the load-lifter straps to a 45 degree angle.
title: TrailPack 45 fitting guide

text: The TrailPack 45 has a 5 year warranty covering zippers and seams. Repairs are free during the first year of ownership. After that, repairs use the standard $25 flat rate.
title: TrailPack 45 warranty

text: The EmberStove weighs 98 g and boils 1 liter of water in 3.5 minutes. It produces 3000W of output and has a piezo igniter. It works with standard isobutane canisters.
title: EmberStove specifications

text: Never use the EmberStove inside a tent or enclosed space. Keep the stove at least 1 meter from flammable materials. Check the O-ring seal before each use and store canisters below 40C.
title: EmberStove safety

text: A 230g isobutane canister lasts about 60 minutes on high with the EmberStove. Cold-weather performance drops below -5C, so use a winter fuel mix in freezing conditions. Always carry a spare canister on trips longer than two days.
title: EmberStove fuel

text: The StormShell jacket is a 3-layer waterproof breathable shell rated 20,000mm/20,000g. It weighs 280 g and has pit zips for ventilation. The hood is helmet-compatible and fully adjustable.
title: StormShell jacket specifications

text: Machine wash the StormShell jacket cold with a technical cleaner. Tumble dry on low to reactivate the DWR coating. Do not use fabric softener, and reapply DWR spray after 20 washes.
title: StormShell jacket care

text: The StormShell jacket has a lifetime warranty covering delamination and seam failure. Summitline offers one free DWR reapplication per jacket. Warranty claims are decided in 3 business days on average.
title: StormShell jacket warranty

text: Summitline offers free standard shipping on orders over $75. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days from the Reno, NV warehouse. Express 2-day shipping costs $18 and is not available to PO boxes.
title: Shipping policy

text: Returns are accepted within 60 days for unused products with tags attached. A free return label is included with every order. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
title: Returns policy

text: All Summitline products are covered against manufacturing defects. Warranty claims are submitted through the website form. The average claim decision takes 3 business days.
title: General warranty terms

text: The Summitline repair program charges a $25 flat rate plus parts. Mail-in repairs take about 2 weeks door to door. Members can request loaner gear while their item is being repaired.
title: Repair program

text: Summitline recalled EmberStove units from batch ES-2409 because the piezo igniter may fail. Owners can request a free replacement igniter. Check the batch code printed on the base of the stove.
title: EmberStove recall notice

text: Summitline Circle membership costs $30 per year. Members get 10% off all purchases and free express shipping. Members also get early access to sales and discounted repairs.
title: Summitline Circle membership

text: Summitline matches prices from authorized retailers within 14 days of purchase. The price match excludes marketplace sellers and clearance items. Submit a claim with a link to the lower price.
title: Price match policy

text: Summitline gift cards never expire and carry no fees. They are available as emailed or physical cards. Gift cards can be redeemed online and in all Summitline stores.
title: Gift cards

text: Summitline stores are located in Reno, NV, Boulder, CO, and Portland, OR. Weekday hours are 9am to 8pm and Sunday hours are 10am to 6pm. The Reno flagship offers gear rentals and a repair counter.
title: Store locations

text: Always dry the RidgeTent 2P fully before storage to prevent mildew. Clean it with mild soap and lukewarm water only. Reapply seam sealer once a year and store the tent loosely in a cool, dry place.
title: RidgeTent 2P care

text: To clean the TrailPack 45, empty all pockets and spot clean with a damp cloth. Air dry the pack away from direct sunlight. Never machine wash the pack, and lubricate the zippers twice a year.
title: TrailPack 45 care

text: The StormShell jacket is true to size, so order your normal size. Size up if you plan to wear heavy layers underneath. Chest measurements are S 34-36 inches, M 38-40 inches, and L 42-44 inches.
title: StormShell jacket sizing
